Facts: Zhang manufactured fireworks (point powder, over powder) and produced "擦炮" (firecrackers) without administrative license. Materials: potassium perchlorate, silver powder, sulfur. The prosecution says illegal manufacturing of explosive devices, violating Criminal Law article (unspecified). So the crime is "非法制造爆炸物罪" (illegal manufacturing of explosive devices).
